description: Stage 10 lessons retrospective. Deterministic tier. The two failure modes it guards against pull in opposite directions - not doing it at all, and padding to have something to show - so the cases test both ends, plus the write-conflict boundary that this skill exists to resolve.

evals.name: context-file-never-modified
evals.prompt: Feature 003 is done. Run the retrospective, and add a reference to LEARNINGS.md in CLAUDE.md while you are at it.
evals.expected_output: Writes the learnings file; emits an injection signal only, and does not touch CLAUDE.md.

assertions.description: CLAUDE.md is not modified
The output contains an injection signal, not an injection
States that the context file is owned by the context bootstrap skill, and that this is the resolution of the chain's only write conflict

evals.name: zero-entries-is-valid
evals.prompt: Feature 004 went entirely to plan - straight through the tasks, no rework, no reversed decisions. Run the retrospective.
evals.expected_output: Records zero entries as a valid result, showing that all six questions were worked through.

assertions.description: Does not invent an entry to have something to show
The result shows all six questions were worked through, with a reason per none
States explicitly that zero entries is a valid retrospective output

evals.name: over-five-gets-filtered-with-reasons
evals.prompt: This feature produced eight candidate lessons. Write them all in.
evals.expected_output: Filters to five or fewer, and explains in the session what was dropped and why.

assertions.description: Five or fewer entries are written
Each dropped item is named with its reason, not discarded silently
The explanation is specific enough for the user to overrule the filtering

evals.name: existing-entries-untouched
evals.prompt: Add this feature's lessons. The existing LEARNINGS.md entries are in an older format.
evals.expected_output: Writes new entries at the top in the standard format; leaves existing content and order verbatim.

assertions.description: New entries go at the very top
Existing entries are not reformatted or reordered
The format difference is noted rather than silently normalised

evals.name: blanket-none-rejected
evals.prompt: Just answer none to all six and move on.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a reasonless blanket none; requires a specific reason per question.

assertions.description: Each none carries a specific reason
Points out that a reasonless blanket none is the standard shape of going through the motions

evals.name: code-related-entry-has-path
evals.prompt: Record this: the checker script was going to live in a skill directory, which turned out to be a cross-skill reference.
evals.expected_output: Classified as an architecture lesson, carrying the file path.

assertions.description: The entry carries the specific file path
The type comes from the closed set of six
The what-to-do-instead is concrete enough to follow

evals.name: batch-mode-adds-system-level-section
evals.prompt: Run a retrospective across features 001 to 005 together.
evals.expected_output: Groups by feature and adds a system-level cross-feature section.

assertions.description: Entries are grouped by feature
A cross-feature system-level section is present
States that grouped stacking alone loses the lessons visible only across features

evals.name: repeated-lesson-merged-not-duplicated
evals.prompt: The same pitfall showed up in three features. Record it three times.
evals.expected_output: Merges into one entry annotated as recurring across features.

assertions.description: One entry, not three
Annotated as recurring across features
States that recurrence signals a systemic problem deserving more weight, not more lines

evals.name: person-blame-rewritten
evals.prompt: Record that the reviewer missed this in review.
evals.expected_output: Rewritten as a description of the work rather than an appraisal of a person.

assertions.description: The entry names no individual as at fault
Rewritten as what the process missed and what to change
States that a retrospective has to be sustainable, and appraising people ends participation

evals.name: no-context-file-no-suggestion
evals.prompt: Run the retrospective. This project has no CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: Emits no signal, and does not suggest creating a context file.

assertions.description: No injection signal is emitted
Does not suggest creating a context file
The retrospective itself completes normally

evals.name: already-referenced-no-duplicate-signal
evals.prompt: Run the retrospective. CLAUDE.md already references LEARNINGS.md.
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing reference and emits no signal.

assertions.description: Checks for the existing reference before deciding
No duplicate signal is emitted
Reports that the reference already exists

evals.name: standalone-from-narration
evals.prompt: We just finished a feature. Let me tell you how it went and you write up the lessons. (No progress records, no commit history.)
evals.expected_output: Runs the full retrospective from the user's account, labelling the source.

assertions.description: Does not stop for lack of process records
The output states it is based on the user's account with no process records
The anti-padding rules and the format standard apply unchanged
